parrafo_1.es: Burrito’s California es un food truck de comida mexicana en Fort Myers. Burritos, tacos, quesadillas y carne asada preparados al momento, en el camión que opera sobre Carrell Rd de lunes a sábado.
parrafo_1.en: Burrito’s California is a Mexican food truck in Fort Myers. Burritos, tacos, quesadillas and carne asada made to order, out of the truck parked on Carrell Rd Monday through Saturday.

parrafo_2.es: Las reseñas en Google lo dicen todo: clientes que vuelven dos días seguidos y burritos que se terminan antes de alcanzar a fotografiarlos. 39 reseñas, todas con 5 estrellas.
parrafo_2.en: The reviews on Google say it all: customers who come back two days in a row, and burritos gone before there was time to photograph them. 39 reviews, every one of them 5 stars.

texto.es: Nos ubicamos en 2011 Carrell Rd, Fort Myers. Abrimos de lunes a sábado desde las 11:30 AM, cerrado los domingos.
texto.en: We park at 2011 Carrell Rd, Fort Myers. Open Monday through Saturday from 11:30 AM, closed Sundays.

texto.es: Pide tu burrito, tacos o plato del día directo en el camión, sin apps ni reservaciones.
texto.en: Order your burrito, tacos or daily plate right at the truck, no apps or reservations.

texto.es: Cada burrito y cada taco se arma cuando lo pides, con carne asada y salsas verde y roja hechas en casa.
texto.en: Every burrito and taco is assembled when you order it, with carne asada and homemade salsa verde and roja.

texto.es: Te lo entregamos envuelto y caliente, listo para comer ahí mismo o llevar.
texto.en: We hand it over wrapped and hot, ready to eat right there or take with you.

nota.es: Consulta el menú del día directamente en el camión, sin compromiso.
nota.en: Check the day’s menu right at the truck, no strings attached.

texto.es: Grandes, envueltos al momento y con carne asada. Las reseñas lo confirman: el burrito se acaba antes de poder fotografiarlo.
texto.en: Big, wrapped fresh, loaded with carne asada. The reviews confirm it: the burrito is gone before there is time to photograph it.

texto.es: Tacos de carne asada con salsa verde y roja hechas en casa, cilantro y cebolla.
texto.en: Carne asada tacos with homemade salsa verde and roja, cilantro and onion.

titulo.en: Chicken and pork chop with tajadas

texto.es: Platos completos con arroz, frijoles, aguacate y tajadas, al estilo hondureño y mexicano.
texto.en: Full plates with rice, beans, avocado and tajadas, Honduran and Mexican style.

texto.es: Quesadillas, baleadas, huarache, torta y nachos para acompañar.
texto.en: Quesadillas, baleadas, huarache, torta and nachos on the side.

pie.es: ¿No ves lo que buscas? Pregunta en la ventanilla, el menú cambia según el día.
pie.en: Don’t see what you’re after? Ask at the window, the menu changes day to day.

items.quote: Hands down best Mexican Food in Fort Myers! I went back two days in a row. There burritos and tacos are absolutely phenomenal and made with love. Truly authentic food here and highly recommend this place!! Will be coming back more often!
The food is amazing. Full of flavor and so worth the price. I recommend this to anyone that is in the area. One of the best food trucks I’ve been to around here. Service is wonderful as well
The burrito was gone before i even got to post this. Best burrito ive had from Fort Myers 100%
The carne asada burrito was so good! The verde and Roja salsas were also delicious
